title: Live PM planned 3-agent 2-task verification
specification:
Create a live autonomy verification run driven by PM planning.

The PM plan must produce exactly 6 implementation tasks total and no reviewer tasks.

Task shape requirements:
- Exactly 2 tasks for aquarium-agent.
- Exactly 2 tasks for adventure-agent.
- Exactly 2 tasks for action-agent.
- Each task must be lane-scoped and atomic.
- Each task should create or update exactly one markdown note file for that lane.
- The two tasks in each lane are intended to land on the same branch so the resulting PR has 2 commits, one commit per task.

Required file targets:
- aquarium-agent task 1 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-165309-aq-1.md
- aquarium-agent task 2 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-165309-aq-2.md
- adventure-agent task 1 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-165309-adv-1.md
- adventure-agent task 2 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-165309-adv-2.md
- action-agent task 1 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-165309-act-1.md
- action-agent task 2 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-165309-act-2.md

Each task acceptance criteria must mention the exact file path it owns.
Use stable task ids derived from prd-live-20260314-165309 with lane suffixes and sequence numbers.
Use sprintId multi-agent-mvp.
requirements: Produce exactly six implementation tasks total.
Produce exactly two tasks for aquarium-agent
Each task must own one exact markdown file path from the specification.
The reviewer should be able to merge one PR per implementation lane after both lane tasks are complete.
